name: B10-0080/2026 (Renew) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Iran's violent crackdown on protesters since late December 2025 and calls for it to stop. It asks Iran to end the killing, release detained protesters, drop charges and restore internet access. It wants the European Union to sanction Iranian officials and the Revolutionary Guard, support secure internet access for Iranians, and invite Iranian opposition figures to speak to the Parliament. The text is the Parliament's position and set of requests; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to sanction Iranian officials and list the Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist group.
- It calls for charges against protesters to be dropped and political prisoners freed.
- It invites opposition figures, including Reza Pahlavi, to address the Parliament.
